name: What is the process for professional window weatherproofing?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional window weatherproofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The professional weatherproofing process typically begins with an inspection to identify air leaks, damaged seals, and areas needing attention. Next, existing degraded caulk and weatherstripping are removed. Surfaces are then cleaned and prepped. High-quality, durable caulking compounds are applied to seal gaps around the window frames, and appropriate weatherstripping is installed along moving sashes. The final step often includes a quality check to ensure a tight, effective seal, improving your home's energy efficiency and comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, removal of old materials, surface prep, application of new caulk and weatherstripping, followed by a quality check.
